mapping: Competitive analysis R02 and product direction N06: invitation image creation is separated from attendance management; all ten descriptions now specify the image outcome.
Competitive analysis W07 and product direction N01/I01: sample card, personalized event information and text editing are connected explicitly.
Competitive analysis R06 and product direction N10: all ten descriptions invite the user to inspect details before sharing; no automatic error-prevention claim.
excluded_from_customer_copy: Market-size, demand, ranking, superiority and comparison claims
Offline guarantees, bilingual workflows, Pro/price promises and per-language version management
Automated validation, correctness guarantees, ten-language UI, AI results, RSVP tracking, hosted QR/links, delivery and cloud-sync promises
research_assessment.boundary: Research is supplied historical evidence, not fresh competitor verification or proof that roadmap features shipped. Internal rationale may name excluded capabilities; these are not customer-facing promises.

active_code_evidence.claim: Illustrated occasion templates, full sample preview, selection
active_code_evidence.finding: Active catalog, rendered sample card and Use Template action exist. Details is accessed by context menu; copy does not invent a tap sequence.

active_code_evidence.claim: Event title, names, date/time, venue/address and personal message
active_code_evidence.finding: quickDetails binds title/hosts, date/time, venue, address and message to the edited invitation. Venue/address apply to in-person/hybrid events.

active_code_evidence.claim: Individual text editing, font choice and on-card appearance
active_code_evidence.finding: Editor opens the selected text editor; changes update draft text and face settings used by rendering. Font selection and preview are implemented.

active_code_evidence.claim: Complete preview, share image, save to Photos
active_code_evidence.finding: Reachable export page renders preview, generates image files, opens UIActivityViewController and writes photo resources after authorization. Copy does not promise delivery, receipt, format selection or automatic checking. Image wording accommodates implemented PNG/GIF paths.

active_code_evidence.claim: English and Simplified Chinese UI; other listing languages are not extra UI languages
active_code_evidence.finding: store.t chooses English or Chinese; Chinese strings are Simplified Chinese. System zh languages select that Chinese branch; other system languages default to English unless explicitly overridden. No additional UI localization is claimed.

keyword_method: Python len on decoded JSON strings counts Unicode code points, including commas and internal spaces. All current strings use BMP characters without combining sequences, so counts also match UTF-16 code units. Exact and NFKC/casefold duplicate checks, full-term name/subtitle overlap checks, and editorial semantic review performed. Near-limit criterion: 95–100 characters.
validation_crosscheck: Independently recomputed all ten keyword counts; all match VALIDATION.json. Verdict is based on actual metadata and code, not its status field.
limitations: Source inspection verifies implemented paths, not successful device execution, actual delivery or Photos authorization on a device.
Local relevance and language assessment is editorial; no search volume or ranking effectiveness is asserted.
No current competitor pages were refreshed; review evaluates faithful use of the two complete supplied reports.
